qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/raw-evidence-index.json (hashes of runtime.json, editor.json, runtime.cjs re-computed and matching)

evidence:
All 50 criteria read (3 gate, 38 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual). Most are well formed for this row: each names a typed/pasted fixture, an exact source or readout readback, an Undo/Redo or reload/second-context/restart readback, and an explicit Fails clause (e.g. functional/judge.toml:29, 101, 128, 155, 308, 317). No criterion asks for a source-file read; gates/constraints/judge.toml:47 uses live-DOM facts only. The visual Likert criteria are subjective by design and have anchors (not a row-32 defect). The following instances are not browser-decidable as written for the configured judge (an LLM driving Playwright MCP 0.0.79 with args '--headless --isolated' only, tests/Dockerfile:19, functional/judge.toml:12):

(1) Sub-three-second action windows. functional/judge.toml:281 (cw_newer_run_supersedes): 'timer after about three seconds. About one second later, before it fires, replace the source with a draft ... and Run it'. functional/judge.toml:272 (cw_stop_cancels_pending_work): 'timer after about three seconds, and press Stop about one second after Run'. functional/judge.toml:245 (cw_output_before_failure_kept): 'schedules a timer for three seconds later and is ended with Stop about one second after Run'. The delay cannot be lengthened past the five-second run budget (behaviour.md:5). The judge must complete Run -> (clear editor, type a new draft with real keys, Run) or Run -> Stop inside ~3 s across separate model turns and tool calls. The only evidence these pass is the scripted golden, which uses exact 1000 ms sleeps in one process (qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/tests/runtime.cjs:67, 104, 112-114); the index states judge duration is not measured. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:23 names 'one-second timing distinctions' as something to avoid.

(2) Undefined probe target. functional/judge.toml:290 (cw_preview_isolation) requires 'confirm that the app page itself can load its own health address' and a preview 'fetch the app's own health address'. The health path (/api/health, integration.md:3) appears nowhere in tests/app_context.md or any prompt (grep 'health' over tests/ hits only judge.toml:290 and :308), while functional/prompt.md:25 says 'Do not guess URL paths or API routes' and :22 forbids changing state from script. The judge has no stated address and no stated way to perform the parent-page control; the scripted golden uses page.evaluate(fetch('/api/health')) (runtime.cjs:126,135), which the judge is not told.

(3) Replay leg depends on app transport. functional/judge.toml:335 (cw_history_restore_retry): 'Repeat the same already completed restore request through the control the app offers for retrying it, or by replaying the recorded request'. policy.md:3 and integration.md:5 leave routes to the builder and no note requires a visible retry control; the golden happens to ship a 'Retry same restore' button (solution/app/src/app.tsx:157; persist.cjs:101). For an app without that button the judge must reconstruct method, URL, headers and JSON body (including any operation id) from the network log and re-issue it from script; an app that sends the restore over a WebSocket has no replayable request at all.

(4) Canvas surface cannot be read back. ui.md:3 allows a 'DOM, canvas or SVG text model' and gates/constraints/judge.toml:47 says 'Passes when the source is drawn by ... canvas'. Yet app_context.md:19 says 'Read the current source from the rendered editor lines', and functional/judge.toml:173 and :182 say 'Inspect the rendered editor text and its computed visible styles'. A canvas editor has no rendered text nodes or per-token computed styles; exact-source readback for multi-line drafts then has no stated method (app_context.md:20 only offers copy into a single-line field).

(5) Minor, probe leaves no distinguishing trace: judge.toml:290 storage leg sets no known value in the origin's localStorage before the preview reads it, so 'obtained nothing' is the same observation for an isolated and a non-isolated preview; the parent document/title leg carries the discrimination.

No configured LLM judge run exists for this candidate, so none of the above is measured either way.
counterexample: Conforming app that could fail: an app that correctly cancels superseded runs and keeps console history across runs (allowed; behaviour.md does not require clearing). The judge clicks Run on the old draft, then needs several tool calls to replace the source and Run again; these take longer than 3 s, so the old timer fires legitimately before the newer Run and 'old-marker' is in the console. The criterion then reads 'Fails if the old marker appears anywhere after the newer Run' (judge.toml:281) and the conforming app is failed. Broken app that could pass: an app that never cancels pending timers of a replaced run but clears the console and preview on each Run; the old timer has already fired before the judge's late second Run, nothing fires afterwards, the old marker is absent and the criterion passes without supersession ever being exercised. The same lateness makes cw_stop_cancels_pending_work fail a correct app (marker appears before the judge reaches Stop). Second conforming alternative: a canvas-drawn editor (explicitly allowed by ui.md:3) cannot satisfy the 'computed visible styles' readback in judge.toml:173/182.
suggested_fix: Make the race window independent of judge latency: have the fixture trigger the delayed work from a visible preview control or use a delay the judge can beat within the public rules (for example a timer of about four seconds started by the draft, with the criterion stating that if the marker appeared before Stop or before the newer Run was pressed, the attempt is void and must be repeated once, and only output appearing after that action counts). State the health address in tests/app_context.md and how the parent-page control is performed (open it in a tab). In cw_history_restore_retry, say what the judge does when the app offers no retry control and no replayable HTTP request (score that leg from the observable 'no fifth revision' via the offered control only, or drop the replay alternative together with a public note requiring a retry control). Tell the judge how to read source and token colours from a canvas or SVG surface (screenshot comparison plus select-all/copy), or narrow the public allowance. These are task-specific criterion and context edits; no shared harness change is needed. A configured judge run is still required to measure feasibility.
